articles.title: Two new lightweight Casio G-Shock watches launching globally
articles.description: The Casio G-Shock BGA-290SA-6A and BGA-290SA-7A watches have been listed on the brand’s international website. This is a relatively lightweight Baby-G model, with a hybrid watch face and 10 ATM water resistance.

articles.title: Microsoft Paint is now one of the weirdest ways to play Doom.
articles.description:
The humble drawing app has gotten several useful upgrades over the past few years, but Mark Russinovich, the Microsoft Azure CTO, has found a way for Paint to play Doom… kind of. Instead of actually running the game, DoomPaint loads rendered frames into the app from the Windows clipboard at a very playable 35fps.
[Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/08/doompaint.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]

articles.title: WarmySender AI Automates Cold Email, LinkedIn and Instagram Outreach
articles.description: Let ChatGPT, Claude, and other MCP-compatible assistants build, launch, and adjust cold-email, LinkedIn, and Instagram campaigns within safe sending limits — and new platform data shows the approach pays: verifying recipients before sending cuts bounce rates by more than 96.67%%. WarmySender, the all-in-one outreach platform, today detailed how marketers can run their outreach on autopilot
